name: v4.1.4: Token Gesture
body:
Generated CLIs now preserve remote transports, empty arrays, and parameters whose names collide with their own helpers; mounted servers honor session visibility and `mounted_components_raise_on_load_error`, a stale client context no longer closes a newer session, and OAuth provider wrappers accept identity assertions. Tasks accept a redis-py credential provider that returns current credentials for each new connection (streaming providers such as redis-entraid's are rejected until Docket can refresh them safely), Redis 8.1.0 is excluded, and custom `KeyringStore` users must now install `py-key-value-aio[keyring]` explicitly. Thanks to our 16 contributors, including 9 first-time contributors.

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### Enhancements ✨
* Add server authoring guidance through the docs site by @zzstoatzz in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5703
* Support rotating Redis credentials for tasks by @zzstoatzz and @nazarii-plebanskyi-rf in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5970
* fix(client): forward max_sse_event_size through StreamableHttpTransport by @PrathmeshPawar2110 in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/6016
* Add a downstream smoke for Redis credential providers by @zzstoatzz in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/6044
### Security 🔒
* Bump certifi to 2026.10.19 by @jakekaplan in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5989
* Let configured proxy headers replace forwarded ones regardless of case by @leopranzl in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5972
### Fixes 🐞
* Fix maintained skill discovery on the docs site by @zzstoatzz in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5954
* Publish regular skill files for Mintlify discovery by @zzstoatzz in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5956
* Serialize HTTP and SSE transports in generate-cli by @asasemahmed in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5891
* fix(cli): preserve empty arrays in generated commands by @dailyun in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5961
* Fix session visibility lookups through mounted servers by @HootRock and @leopranzl in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5966
* Fix generated CLI JSON parameter name collisions by @Vittuu in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5959
* Escape server text in the fastmcp call elicitation prompt by @asasemahmed in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5909
* Map common audio extensions when Audio is given a path by @asasemahmed in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5919
* Drop clamped log records the logger is not enabled for by @asasemahmed in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5915
* Omit the output schema when an OpenAPI success response has no body by @asasemahmed in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5913
* Create the MCP config file on install when it is missing or empty by @asasemahmed in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5887
* Preserve credential providers when cloning task extensions by @zzstoatzz and @nazarii-plebanskyi-rf in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5984
* Exclude Redis 8.1.0 to preserve task reconnection by @zzstoatzz and @nazarii-plebanskyi-rf in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5985
* Remove unused keyring dependency by @zzstoatzz and @tom42-otera in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5987
* Fix static checks broken by ty 0.0.89 and pydantic 2.14 by @zzstoatzz in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/6001
* Run dev inspector servers over stdio and stop mapping the deployment port to the proxy by @asasemahmed in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/6029
* fix(json-schema): apply a Draft-4 boolean exclusive bound to its sibling by @kbkb628 in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5234
* Strip a URL scheme from a Clerk domain by @asasemahmed in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5921
* Fix generate-cli commands for tools with a json parameter by @andreivince in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/6032
* Honor mounted_components_raise_on_load_error in AggregateProvider by @asasemahmed in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/6026
* Reject streaming credential providers in TasksExtension by @zzstoatzz in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/6043
* fix(client): keep stale contexts from closing newer sessions by @mikamikasuki in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/6018
* fix(auth): expose identity assertions on OAuth provider wrappers by @computeaholic and @jonaseck2 in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/6006
* Measure blocking duration with perf_counter in transform_fn generator test by @Lokeshrao69 in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/6014
### Docs 📚
* Clarify request state across mounted servers by @HootRock and @leopranzl in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5967
* Pass mcp_path through the remote OAuth custom routes example by @asasemahmed in https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5925
